title: What the week changed
description: All four fields may be empty. A week that changed nothing is a valid week.

report.description: For the owner: what changed, and what it was based on, in their language.

lesson.description: One claim. Not a paragraph of advice — something the next review can confirm or refute.

post_ids.description: One post is an anecdote. Code rejects a lesson with fewer than two.

numbers.description: The figures behind the claim, stated plainly.

retires.description: The id of the active lesson this one contradicts. A contradicting lesson may not sit beside the old one.

n.description: How many posts sit behind this call. Code applies the change only above the floor in settings.

cannot_tell.description: Where the data does not answer the question — above all, what sold rather than what travelled.
